name: Noah's Ark
hook: The Genesis flood story: an ark of gopher wood, a dove with an olive leaf and a rainbow promise.

facts.label: the ark
facts.statement: Genesis says God told Noah to build the ark of gopher wood, 300 cubits long and 50 wide, with eight people aboard.

facts.label: Mount Ararat
facts.statement: Mount Ararat, a 16,900-foot peak in Turkey, is the traditional resting place of Noah's Ark; astronaut James Irwin searched there.

facts.label: the raven and the dove
facts.statement: Noah first sends a raven, then a dove, which returns with an olive leaf; the constellation Columba is "Noah's dove."

facts.label: the rainbow
facts.statement: The rainbow in the cloud is God's sign to Noah that he will never again flood the earth.

facts.label: Methuselah
facts.statement: Methuselah, Noah's grandfather, lives 969 years — the longest life in the Bible.

facts.label: Ham
facts.statement: Ham, one of Noah's three sons, sees his father naked and is cursed; his brothers are Shem and Japheth.

facts.label: Nimrod
facts.statement: Nimrod, Noah's great-grandson, is a mighty hunter; Bugs Bunny used his name to insult Elmer Fudd.
